summary: 0.28.0 report bundle for a clean green run (review APPROVE round 2, test PASS round 2, 0 open of 13 findings; gofmt/vet/go test -race re-run green, gogo --version 0.28.0). plan.md reconciled to as-built with all five in-flight corrections marked inline rather than hidden: A2 (capture-pane needs the PANE target '=name:' - the accepted FR1.5 text was wrong and would have broken every log peek), REV-001 (the unfloored dash cut), A3 (the fold additionally wired at cli/plan.go:451/:569, a file the checklist never listed - recorded as an orchestrator scope call), A4 (read-side session back-compat for pre-0.28.0 names) and A5 (the CONFIRM-DEFAULT CONVENTION, the user's call). Wrote report/report.md leading with the real root cause (tmux refuses a command line over ~16317 bytes, the plans tab inlined the whole brief, the user's spawn was 20128 bytes, and .Run() discarded the stderr that said so), the three briefing guesses measured FALSE (session-name length, an existing TUI enum-sync test, tmux shelling out), the prefix-target hazard (kill-session -t gogo-plan-foo killed gogo-plan-foobar-long), and what review caught that implementation missed - including three shipped wirings whose reverts left the suite green, plus the mutation methodology (compile-check first; a compensated mutation is blind). Diagram set chosen by the diff: flow/sequence/activity re-used as-built plus a NEW class diagram of the added types; no use-case (would restate the sequence). charts/before/ copied to report/before/ with re-pointed file paths; both manifests validate against charts-manifest.schema.json; layouts.json prebuilt for both sets (vnm 0.7.1 present, 4 + 3 laid out, 0 skipped). Knowledge: 0.28.0 entry in project-knowledge.md's gogo overrides (proxy - overrides section only, no upstream file touched, no Custom section touched), tmux platform constraints + a corrected test count in tech-stack.md, a new Diagnosability bar in non-functional-requirements.md, review checks #10/#11 in code-review-standards.md, and the mutation-sweep rules in test-strategy.md. Honest gaps recorded in the report: events.jsonl is missing all review events, implement round 4 and test round 2; state.md was stale on entry (implement/implementing/test=1) and is corrected here; project-knowledge.md is now 415 lines, OVER the knowledge budget, so /gogo:skills extraction is flagged; and gogo's own gogo-knowledge/gogo-mermaid skills still reference a report/diagrams.html that 0.27.0 removed. Known limitations carried forward: D5's cross-repo same-slug cap over-count (reproduced, deliberately deferred) and the fact that pre-0.28.0 sessions attribute only via the read-side widening. The user's two live tmux sessions were verified present and untouched throughout. Left at status awaiting-uat, NOT done.
